definitions.explanation: Describes performing an action with notable skill or cleverness. Can convey positive admiration for technique or a negative nuance of cunning manipulation, depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巧|たく}みに⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巧|たく}みに⟦かわした→かわす：28851_kawasu⟧。
⟦{詐欺師|さぎし}→詐欺師：10176_sagishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巧|たく}みな⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{騙|だま}した→騙す：02286_damasu⟧。
examples.english: The swindler deceived people with clever tricks.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧ (na-adjective meaning skillful/clever). Describes actions performed with notable skill or cleverness. Can be used both positively (impressive skill) and negatively (cunning manipulation).

USAGE:
When used with neutral or positive verbs, it praises skill and dexterity. When used with verbs like ⟦{騙|だま}す→騙す：02286_damasu⟧ (to deceive) or ⟦かわす→かわす：28851_kawasu⟧ (to dodge), it implies craftiness or cunning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巧|たく}みに⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧: to manipulate skillfully
- {巧|たく}みに⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use skillfully
- {巧|たく}みに⟦かわす→かわす：28851_kawasu⟧: to dodge deftly
- {巧|たく}みな⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: skillful technique
- {巧|たく}みな⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧: skillful way of speaking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: skillfully — the everyday, neutral word for doing something well
- ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: deftly — emphasizes manual dexterity or versatility
- {巧|たく}みに: adds a literary quality and can imply cleverness or cunning that the others lack
